title: Underwater Acoustic Beacon – Beacon: Acoustic, Underwater, 90-Day
description: The DuKane underwater acoustic beacon is designed to generate a signal that radiates underwater to a distance of about 2 miles. Works to a depth of 20, 000 feet. Operated by a field replaceable lithium battery. Meets MIL-I-45208A. FAA TSO-C121 and British CAA AR-01085 Approved. Also approved by the U.S. Navy and Government/Military installation (NWSCESD91-103)
